displayName: loop-sessions: no health reports for 20 min

documentation.content:
No laptop has had a health report accepted for twenty minutes. Every enrolled agent posts one every five minutes (about 336 an hour across the fleet), so zero for twenty minutes is not a quiet fleet: the server, the TLS path in front of it, or the whole fleet's network is down.

Check the server first: `curl -i __PUBLIC_URL__/readyz` (expect `ready`) and the readiness alert. Then `gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.service_name="loop-sessions" AND jsonPayload.message="ingest request failed" AND jsonPayload.op="put health report"' --limit=10 --freshness=1h`: a report the store refused is answered 5xx on purpose so the fleet page never shows a machine as reporting when it is not. If the server is healthy and the log is empty, the requests are not arriving: check the Cloud Run request log for /v1/health at all.

Runbook: examples/deploy-gcp/README.md#runbook-ingest-5xx
